items.fullTextContent:
Full-featured RSS & Atom reader showing all metadata fields for iOS 6

Most RSS readers only display a headline, a preview snippet, and maybe a thumbnail. RealNews is designed to parse and reveal every single XML tag, custom namespace, author link, enclosure, and metadata field embedded in RSS 0.9x/1.0/2.0 and Atom feeds. Built from the ground up for iOS 6 with native Mbed TLS 1.3 encryption (direct HTTPS without proxies), clean skeuomorphic linen and glossy styling, an article reader mode with full-table metadata inspection, customizable cache expiration, and an iPad split-view experience.

Unofficial apps by samcejko, not affiliated with or endorsed by Twitch, Google, Apple, TikTok, Instagram, Meta, Spotify, Kick, NVIDIA, Mojang, Microsoft, OpenRouter, Vine, X, diVine or the Moonlight, Sunshine and Apollo projects.

extraData.description: Point your camera at a math problem to scan, solve and see step-by-step calculations. items.title: New app: Surfari 1.2.0

extraData.description: A web browser that opens today's websites on iOS 6. What's new: Play in the background (Settings > Pages, on by default): music and videos of a page go on when you leave the app or lock the screen - an internet radio, a YouTube video, a live stream; the lock screen's and a headset's buttons pause and resume them and the lock screen shows the page's title; Log in with cookies (long press Reload) keeps the cookies for the page's own site, a leading www. dropped - no longer for the last two labels of its name, which for sites under co.uk, github.io and the like would have sent them to every site there; Cookies of the same name that the site had set before are replaced, and if the import does not take, everything is put back as it was
